Bugatti represents the pinnacle of modern hypercar engineering, and the Chiron is no exception. An extraordinary fusion of power, craftsmanship, and presence. Beautifully finished here in Bugatti Light Blue & Nocturne, a striking two-tone specification that emphasises the car’s sculpted lines and unmistakable identity. The contrast between the vibrant Light Blue and the deep, elegant Nocturne creates a visual character that is both dynamic and timeless, showcasing the Chiron’s design with exceptional clarity.
Underneath its captivating exterior lies Bugatti’s 8.0-litre quad-turbocharged W16 engine, delivering 1,479 horsepower through its four wheel drive system. The Chiron’s meticulous engineering provide effortless acceleration acheiving a 0-186mph time of just 13.6 seconds. Whether cruising comfortably or demonstrating its immense performance capability, the Chiron offers a driving experience unlike others.
This particular Chiron is accompanied by a collection of highly desirable factory items that further elevate the provenance of this iconic car.
